SELECT v.id, v.user_id, v.store_id, v.rating, v.content, r.type, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM review v JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND WHERE v.store_id = #{storeId}
SELECT v.id, v.user_id, v.store_id, v.rating, v.content, r.type, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM review v JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND WHERE v.id = #{id}
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM review v JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND WHERE v.id = #{id} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (id, user_id, store_id, rating, content) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{storeId}, #{rating}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE review v JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND SET v.rating = #{dto.rating}, v.content = #{dto.content}, r.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE review v JOIN root r ON v.id = r.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND SET r.deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.user_id = #{userId}
